label: Main Menu Launcher
summary: Nine-squares "Main Menu" launcher in the top banner.
note: Role is 'navigation' (a nav landmark), not 'button'; click it to reveal the Main Menu panel.

label: Import Document Menu Item
summary: "Import Document" item in the Main Menu Document group.

label: Document Retrieval Menu Item
summary: "Document Retrieval" item in the Main Menu Document group (search screen).

label: Import Document Iframe
summary: The Import Document iframe (FileUploadEnhanced.aspx). Resolve once, then pass the FrameLocator to the field selectors below.
note: Returns a FrameLocator, not a Locator; used to scope all importForm field selectors. Not a user-visible element — emit as scrape to represent 'enter/read the iframe context'.

label: Choose File (Hidden File Input)
summary: Hidden <input type=file> behind the "Choose File" button. Drive with .setInputFiles(path).
note: Must be called inside the NavPanelIFrame frame context (importForm.frame). Use .setInputFiles(path), not .click().

label: Document Type Groups — Select
summary: "Document Type Groups" combobox — pick <All>, Payroll Records, or Personnel Records.
note: Drive with .selectOption({ label }). Filters the Document Types dropdown.

label: Document Type Groups — Scrape
summary: Read the currently selected document type group from the combobox.

label: Document Types — Select
summary: "Document Types" combobox — pick the X_HR_* type (e.g. X_HR_Emergency Contact).
note: Must be set before typing UCPath ID + Tab so the Employee Lookup keyset fires with the correct document type context.

label: Document Types — Scrape
summary: Read the currently selected X_HR_* document type from the combobox.

label: File Type — Select
summary: "File Type" combobox — pick PDF (.pdf); defaults to Image File Format.
note: Always select 'PDF (.pdf)' explicitly — default is Image File Format which is incorrect for HR docs.

label: File Type — Scrape
summary: Read the currently selected file type from the combobox.

label: Keyset Lookup — Select
summary: "Keyset Lookup" combobox — pick 'Employee Lookup' to enable UCPath ID autofill.
note: Must be set before clicking keysetApplyButton; 'Employee Lookup' autofills all keywords except Document Name when UCPath ID + Tab is fired.

label: Keyset Lookup — Scrape
summary: Read the currently selected keyset from the combobox.

label: Apply Keyset Button
summary: Apply-keyset (key icon) button beside the Keyset Lookup select.
note: Accessible name matches the adjacent select ('Keyset Lookup') — both share the label. Click after selecting the keyset to arm it.

label: Keyword Textbox (Generic) — Fill
summary: Generic keyword textbox by OnBase label (e.g. 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Middle Name', 'Suffix', 'Document Name').
note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly (exact: true). Use concrete selectors (ucpathIdInput, documentNameInput) for the primary key and Document Name; use this for all other text keywords autofilled by the keyset.

label: Keyword Textbox (Generic) — Scrape
summary: Read a keyword value by OnBase label — useful to verify keyset autofill results.
note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly (exact: true).

label: Keyword Combobox (Dataset-backed) — Select
summary: Generic dataset-backed keyword combobox by OnBase label (Department Name, Department Code, Vice Chancellor, Vice Chancellor Code).
note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly. These fields are comboboxes (dataset-backed), not plain textboxes — use selectOption or appropriate Playwright combobox fill, not .fill().

label: Keyword Combobox (Dataset-backed) — Scrape
summary: Read a dataset-backed keyword value by OnBase label — e.g. verify keyset populated Department Name.
note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly.

label: UCPath ID Input — Fill
summary: The UCPath ID keyword textbox — the primary key; type it + Tab to fire the Employee Lookup keyset autofill.
note: After filling, press Tab to trigger the Employee Lookup keyset — autofills all keywords except Document Name. If the keyset does not populate (unknown UCPath ID), fill required keywords manually from OCR/person-lookup data.

label: UCPath ID Input — Scrape
summary: Read the current value of the UCPath ID keyword textbox.

label: Document Name Input — Fill
summary: The Document Name keyword textbox — the one required field the Employee Lookup keyset does NOT autofill.
note: Must be set manually with the per-doc-type constant (e.g. 'EMERGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION' for X_HR_Emergency Contact). Required ('red') field — Import button stays disabled until populated.

label: Document Name Input — Scrape
summary: Read the current value of the Document Name keyword textbox.

label: Import Submit Button
summary: The "Import" submit button — disabled until a file and all required keywords are present.
note: Gate on isImportEnabled() before clicking — commits a real document to OnBase. Never click in a dry run.

label: Clear Keywords Button
summary: "Clear Keywords" button — reset keyword fields without losing the attached file.

label: Clear All Button
summary: "Clear All" button — reset the whole import form including the attached file.
